description: x402 test payment: can this wallet pay an x402 API? A paid call of a fraction of a cent in USDC on Base or Solana that returns a signed receipt, proof that the wallet, its spending limit and its x402 client (an AgentCore payments session, a CDP or Privy wallet, or any other client) complete a real paid call end to end, plus what Agoranome already knows about the wallet. For an agent's first payment, before it buys anything bigger. Price: $0.001 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Same price over HTTP, which any x402 client pays without MCP (prefer it if your client pays HTTP 402s): GET https://api.agoranome.com/v1/machine/ping. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $0.001 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

kyapay-token.description: A Skyfire pay or kya-pay token made for Agoranome's service, from a client that can't set the kyapay-token header. Leave it out when paying with x402 or the header.
